title: High-pressure-steam piping and high temperature hot water piping.
officialText:
High-pressure-steam piping and high temperature
hot water piping regulated by Section 1210 of the New York City Mechanical Code, shall be subject to special inspection in
accordance with this section. Special inspection of seismic bracing shall be performed in accordance with Section 1707.7.
